 1import os
 2from dataset_builder import DatasetBuilder, RelationalDataset
 3
 4# --- Configuration ---
 5builder_path = os.path.join('llm_baseline_data', 'dataset_builder.pickle')
 6new_data_dir = os.path.join('llm_baseline_data', 'data')
 7
 8# --- Load existing builder ---
 9builder = DatasetBuilder.load(builder_path)
10
11# --- Update data_dir so save() uses the new directory ---
12builder.data_dir = new_data_dir
13
14# --- Update test sample image paths ---
15updated_test_samples = []
16original_paths = []
17
18for idx, (img_path, question, answer, question_vector, matrix) in enumerate(builder.test_samples):
19    filename = os.path.basename(img_path)
20    new_img_path = os.path.join(new_data_dir, filename)
21
22    if idx < 2:
23        original_paths.append((img_path, new_img_path))
24
25    updated_test_samples.append((new_img_path, question, answer, question_vector, matrix))
26
27builder.test_samples = updated_test_samples
28
29# --- Print before and after for first 2 updated samples ---
30print("Example of updated paths:")
31for old_path, new_path in original_paths:
32    print(f"OLD: {old_path}")
33    print(f"NEW: {new_path}\n")
34
35# --- Rebuild test_dataset with updated paths ---
36builder.test_dataset = RelationalDataset(
37    builder.test_samples,
38    builder.vocab,
39    builder.answer_vocab,
40    builder.max_len,
41    transform=builder.transform,
42    transform_prob=builder.transform_prob,
43    random_seed=builder.random_seed
44)
45
46# --- Save updated builder ---
47save_path = builder.save()
48print(f"Updated DatasetBuilder saved to: {save_path}")
